issues.detail: The Greek 'αρτι' (arti) means 'now'. The Vietnamese translation 'vậy' (thus/so) fails to capture the temporal immediacy of 'now' which is central to the command.

The Greek 'πρεπον' (prepon) implies something that is 'fitting', 'proper', or 'becoming'. The Vietnamese 'nên' (should/ought to) captures the obligation but misses the nuance of it being the 'fitting/proper' course of action.
